unverified_statements.text: Possible effect of RULE-077's account match: a payment or credit posted on another account (for example a firm's account paying for a member) that settles a member's invoice will not be in brnz_subs_invoice_line. Later payment-method and payer-type rules that read payment lines (for example DOUBLE_PAYMENT) would then not see it.
unverified_statements.reason: This is a consequence I reasoned out; no artefact records it. The pack states only the confirmed rule (such rows are not landed). The team should confirm whether the consequence matters before it goes in Known limitations.
